recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the only visible current-source stale Profile-resource wording found in this investigation; remaining uses of Profile should be interpreted through the later FHIR-16414 glossary unless a separate issue identifies a specific inconsistency.
issue_request: FHIR-5585 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and asked FHIR to avoid the confusing resource name Profile; the accepted resolution renamed Profile to StructureDefinition and separated broader profiling terminology from the resource name.
initial_application: The historical application trail includes 2b54214 merging Profile and ExtensionDefinition into StructureDefinition, 9d234906 replacing many StructureDefinition element-definition references from profile to StructureDefinition, and ebc8bdf applying #5585 at SVN 4492. Current fhir.ini has StructureDefinition as the active resource and no active Profile resource, but the active EHR-FM appendix still contained the stale phrase 'Conformance Statement and Resource Profile resources'.
additional_context: FHIR-16414 later reached Published/Not Persuasive with Modification and intentionally clarified current terminology so Profile means a constrained StructureDefinition, while Implementation Guide and Package cover broader collections. The current profiling glossary follows that later decision. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-5585 and the Conformance Package/Profile terminology found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Updated source/ehr-fm.html TI.5.4 to say 'CapabilityStatement and StructureDefinition resources' instead of 'Conformance Statement and Resource Profile resources'. The page is included by source/hierarchy.xml and source/implsupport-module.html, so the edit applies to current build-scope narrative.
source_changes: source/ehr-fm.html: updated the TI.5.4 Interchange Agreements sentence from old Conformance Statement/Resource Profile resource names to current CapabilityStatement/StructureDefinition resource names.

related_jiras.note: Later Published terminology decision defining Profile as constraints represented by a StructureDefinition; it explains why current profile glossary wording is not reverted to the DSTU1 Conformance Package phrasing.
